process_area.title: Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence

value_stream.name: Consumer Data Privacy & Data Protection Program

fields.Participants: DPO, Project Sponsor, IT, Legal, Security
fields.Trigger: New initiative/system processing personal data, or material change
fields.Volume: New product launches, app features, analytics/AI use cases

workflows.name: Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) & DPIA for New Initiatives

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "DPO/Steering Committee decide on processing" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
- operational: PIA gate in project intake
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-gate risk**: Privacy considered after launch; mitigated by PIA gate in project intake
System Touchpoints: - PIA/DPIA register; project intake gate (links to VS-30); decision log

steps.activity: Project Sponsor completes PIA screening for new initiative (app feature, loyalty analytics, AI/profiling, biometrics); DPO determines if full DPIA required (high-risk)
DPO leads DPIA: necessity/proportionality, risks to subjects, mitigations, residual risk, and go/no-go recommendation; consults subjects where appropriate
DPO/Steering Committee decide on processing; mandate mitigations; document decision; re-review on material change

fields.Participants: DPO, Legal, IT, Vendor Mgmt, Finance
fields.Volume: Cloud/SaaS vendors, regional marketplaces, group entities

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "country adequacy per NPC guidance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approved transfer mechanisms" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents transfer register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unlawful-transfer risk**: Transfers without safeguards breach DPA; mitigated by transfer register and safeguards
System Touchpoints: - Transfer register; cloud region config (links to VS-27); contract repository (links to VS-03)

steps.activity: DPO/Legal identify cross-border transfers (cloud regions, marketplace platforms, group sharing); assess destination-country adequacy per NPC guidance
Legal/DPO implement appropriate safeguards: contractual clauses, binding corporate rules for group entities, or NPC-approved transfer mechanisms
DPO monitors regulatory changes affecting transfers; renews safeguards; documents transfer register; suspends non-compliant transfers

fields.Participants: Vendor Mgmt, DPO, Legal, IT Security

workflows.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "Vendor Mgmt/DPO screen vendors processing personal data" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "audit rights, deletion on exit" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Processor-risk**: Vendor mishandles data exposing BuildRight; mitigated by DPA and due diligence
System Touchpoints: - Vendor onboarding (links to VS-03); contract/DPA repository (links to VS-88); sub-processor register

steps.activity: Vendor Mgmt/DPO screen vendors processing personal data; assess privacy posture (certifications, security, sub-processors, breach history)
Legal/DPO execute Data Processing Agreement (DPA) defining purpose, data, sub-processors, security, breach notice, audit rights, deletion on exit
Vendor Mgmt integrate DPA requirement into vendor onboarding (links to VS-03) and contract lifecycle; block non-compliant processors

fields.Participants: DPO, Internal Audit, IT Security, Vendor Mgmt

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-schedule of "schedule oversight based on data sensitivity and volume" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "logs, sub-processor changes, deletion evidence" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-escalate of "escalate unresolved issues" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-153 (ensure privacy consent, DSAR & processor oversight.)
- operational: annual audit and sub-processor change notice
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unmonitored-processor risk**: Changes at vendor unknown to BuildRight; mitigated by annual audit and sub-processor change notice
System Touchpoints: - Processor inventory/risk tier; audit findings (links to VS-21); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: DPO/Vendor Mgmt maintain processor inventory and risk tier; schedule oversight based on data sensitivity and volume
Internal Audit/IT Security audit high-risk processors (security controls, access logs, sub-processor changes, deletion evidence); review certifications
DPO/Vendor Mgmt remediate findings; escalate unresolved issues; suspend/exit processors per DPA breach provisions

fields.Participants: DPO, IT, Data Governance, Records, Business Process Owners

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-collect of "collect only necessary personal data" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-record of "Records/DPO define retention schedule per data category aligned to…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "IT embeds privacy-by-design defaults" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-collection risk**: Excess data inflates breach impact; mitigated by minimization reviews
System Touchpoints: - Retention scheduling (links to VS-88); access control/encryption (links to VS-27); minimization review

steps.activity: DPO/Data Governance apply data minimization: collect only necessary personal data; challenge purpose vs. fields collected at each touchpoint
Records/DPO define retention schedule per data category aligned to BIR/SEC/Consumer Act retention and DPA minimization; automate deletion/pseudonymization post-retention
IT embeds privacy-by-design defaults (privacy-preserving config, access control, encryption, audit logging) into new systems per W3049

fields.Participants: Data Governance, IT, DPO, Data Analytics
fields.Trigger: Analytics, reporting, or non-production data use

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validate re-identification risk" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-capture of "enters analytics/AI/test environments" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "logs access to re-identification keys" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
- operational: technique validation and key access control
Pain Points / Risks: - **Re-identification risk**: Pseudonymized data re-identified; mitigated by technique validation and key access control
System Touchpoints: - De-identification/masking tooling (links to VS-28); test-data management; access logging (links to VS-27)

steps.activity: Data Governance/DPO determine de-identification/anonymization technique for each analytics use case; validate re-identification risk
IT/Data Analytics apply techniques (pseudonymization, aggregation, masking) before data enters analytics/AI/test environments; prohibit raw PII in non-prod
DPO audits de-identification effectiveness; restricts and logs access to re-identification keys; reviews AI/profiling for privacy impact

workflows.name: CCTV / Surveillance Privacy Impact & Signage Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-document of "document lawful basis" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "Store Ops/LP install compliant privacy signage at all monitored" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-schedule of "LP/DPO enforce retention and access controls on CCTV footage" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Excess-surveillance risk**: Over-broad CCTV captures private behavior; mitigated by proportionality assessment and signage
System Touchpoints: - CCTV system (links to VS-23); retention/access control (links to VS-27/VS-88); signage compliance

steps.activity: DPO/LP assess CCTV coverage for necessity and proportionality (security vs. privacy); restrict cameras from private/excess areas; document lawful basis (legitimate security interest)
Store Ops/LP install compliant privacy signage at all monitored entrances/areas; inform visitors of surveillance and purpose
LP/DPO enforce retention and access controls on CCTV footage; restrict viewing to authorized security purposes; delete per retention schedule

workflows.name: Privacy Awareness Training & Employee Compliance Program

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track completion by role" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-503 (ensure controlled execution — Privacy Impact Assessment, Data Mapping & Vendor Privacy Due Diligence (PA-91.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Human-error risk**: Employees mishandle PII; mitigated by role-based training and simulations
System Touchpoints: - L&D/training (links to VS-19); completion tracking; phishing simulation platform

steps.activity: DPO/HR develop role-based privacy training (general awareness, CX/marketing handling PII, IT/data handlers, executive); deploy via L&D (links to VS-19)
HR/L&D ensure completion at onboarding and annual refresh; track completion by role; certify high-risk roles (CX, marketing, IT, finance)
DPO/Compliance run phishing/social-engineering simulations and privacy-incident drills; reinforce via comms; track program effectiveness
